items.title: 14.10.1 Hawa ki aaloodgi se jure bunyadi sehat ke khatre (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.10.1, printed pages 315-316.

blocks.text: Ozone, particulate matter (PM) aur nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) jaise pollutants asthma ki alamaat (symptoms) barha sakte hain aur asthma ka attack la sakte hain. Lambe arse ka exposure purani khansi (chronic cough) aur pneumonia jaisi saans ki infections ka sabab ban sakta hai.
ii) Cardio-vascular diseases (dil aur khoon ki naliyon ki bimariyan)

Particulate matter aur doosre pollutants ka exposure soojan, khoon ki naliyon ko nuqsan aur high blood pressure paida kar ke heart attack ka khatra barhata hai, aur aakhir mein stroke bhi ho sakta hai.
Kuch pollutants, khaas taur par particulate matter (PM) aur cancer paida karne wale (carcinogenic) compounds jaise benzene, ka lamba exposure phephron ka cancer (lung cancer) karta hai.

Air pollution mardon aur auraton dono mein reproductive health (aulad paida karne ki sehat) aur fertility par bura asar dal sakti hai. Bachchon mein waqt se pehle paidaish (premature birth) aur nashonuma (development) ke masail ho sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Sehat ke bare khatre
rows: soojan, naliyon ka nuqsan, high blood pressure, stroke

blocks.prompt: a) Particulate matter (PM) ka air quality par kya asar hai?
blocks.explanation: Hawa mein latke zarre hawa ko dhundla karte hain aur AQI barhate hain. Saans ke saath andar ja kar yeh saans ki naliyon mein soojan aur jalan karte hain, jis se asthma aur bronchitis hote hain; bareek PM2.5 phephron ki gehrai tak ja kar dil ki bimari aur phephron ke cancer ka khatra bhi barhata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) AQI kya hai? Yeh air quality kaise napta hai?
blocks.explanation: AQI (Air Quality Index) kisi khaas jagah ki hawa mein maujood pollutants (PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃) ki concentration ka paimana hai. Napi gai concentrations ko 0 se 500 ke ek number mein badla jata hai; number jitna bara, hawa utni kharab.

blocks.prompt: c) AQI ke mukhtalif darje kya hain? Sab se mehfooz aur sab se khatarnak range batayein.
blocks.explanation: Good 0-50 (green), moderate 51-100 (yellow), unhealthy for sensitive groups 101-150 (orange), unhealthy 151-200 (red), very unhealthy 201-300 (purple), hazardous 301-500 (maroon). Sab se mehfooz 0-50 aur sab se khatarnak 301-500.

items: Saans ki bimariyan (asthma, pneumonia); dil aur naliyon ki bimariyan (heart attack, stroke); cancer (PM, benzene); reproductive aur developmental asraat (fertility, premature birth).
